title: What Is a Good Net Promoter Score?

facts.fact: The page says NPS is measured with the question asking customers to rate, on a 1-10 scale, how likely they are to recommend the business to a friend or colleague.
facts.quote: On a scale of 1-10, how likely is it that you would recommend us to a friend or colleague?

facts.fact: The page classifies NPS promoters as customers who give a score between 9 and 10.
The page classifies NPS passives as customers who give a score between 7 and 8.
The page classifies NPS detractors as customers who give a score between 0 and 6.
The page gives the NPS formula as the percentage of promoters minus the percentage of detractors, and attributes the concept to Fred Reichheld of Bain & Company.
The page states the lowest possible NPS is -100 (every customer a detractor) and the highest is 100 (every customer a promoter).
facts.quote: From the formula given above, the lowest possible score is -100 if every customer is a detractor.

facts.fact: In the page's hypothetical GoDaddy example, 40 of 100 surveyed customers rated the service 9-10.
In the page's hypothetical example of 100 respondents (40 promoters, 35 passives, 25 detractors), the resulting NPS is 15.
facts.quote: Using the formula, the NPS score is = (40%-25%) = 15%

facts.fact: The page reports a 2022-23 average NPS benchmark of 59 for Department/Specialty Stores, citing Retently benchmark data.
The page reports a 2022-23 average NPS benchmark of 29 for Hotels, citing Retently benchmark data.
The page reports a 2022-23 average NPS benchmark of 22 for Airlines, citing Retently benchmark data.
The page reports a 2022-23 average NPS benchmark of 20 for Rideshare & Food delivery, citing Retently benchmark data.
The page reports a 2022-23 average NPS benchmark of 6 for Cable/Satellite TV Services, citing Retently benchmark data.
According to the page's Retently-sourced data, Hotels' average NPS fell from 49 in 2022 to 29 in 2023.
facts.quote: saw the most noticeable decline from 49 in 2022 to 29 in 2023

facts.fact: According to the page's Retently-sourced data, Airlines' average NPS fell from 45 in 2022 to 22 in 2023.
According to the page's Retently-sourced data, Shipping Services' average NPS rose from 27 in 2022 to 35 in 2023.
facts.quote: witnessed a noticeable increase from 2022 (from 27 to 35)

facts.fact: The page states that, theoretically, any score higher than the average competitive set is considered a good NPS.
facts.quote: Theoretically, any score higher than the average competitive set is considered good.
